channel.title: Just.us daily
channel.description: A question, a date idea and a small challenge for two, every day.

item.title: Question for two: What is something you are proud of us for, doing this apart?
item.description: Date idea: Beach day with a sunset finish. Challenge: Trade one compliment that has nothing to do with looks.

item.title: Question for two: What is the best present I have ever given you?
item.description: Date idea: Flea market morning. Challenge: Agree on one screen-free hour this week and protect it.

item.title: Question for two: What is the hardest thing you have ever had to tell someone?
item.description: Date idea: Aquarium or zoo visit. Challenge: Take one small job off your partner's list without mentioning it.

item.title: Question for two: Which game show would the two of us win?
item.description: Date idea: Plan a dream trip. Challenge: Plan one tiny thing to look forward to this weekend and put it in the calendar.

item.title: Question for two: What is a small luxury that makes daily life better for you?
item.description: Date idea: Day trip to a town an hour away. Challenge: Tell your partner about the best moment of your day in three sentences.

item.title: Question for two: Is there a decision we need to make soon?
item.description: Date idea: Cook the same recipe on a call. Challenge: Ask what would make tomorrow easier, and do one part of it.

item.title: Question for two: What was the first meal we cooked together?
item.description: Date idea: Paper-folding challenge. Challenge: Tell your partner about the best moment of your day in three sentences.
